extraction_policy.selected: Whole numbered source sections whose headings name visual identity, rendering/material, colour, type, framing/camera, visual pitfalls or consistency.
extraction_policy.excluded: Sound palette, native-move/story menus, variation plots, engine/code instructions, character/image-generation workflows, footage/source procurement, and editing/motion sections are not independently selected.
extraction_policy.preservation: Selected section text is copied verbatim. Mixed reminders inside a selected source section remain source text, not Blender rules.
extraction_policy.blender: Art excerpts are source references only. Only separately reviewed contract.json files enter the Blender adapter.
